_note: FL31 draft: shipped notes and comments that the code contradicts for the spine flags $FF (a scene setup never wakes the parked palette thinkers; only an inventory close does) and the actor field $24 of hit_switch (read as the event flag $24). Apply after a fresh extract:lt. Partial edits need the stored text to be unchanged; run with --dry-run first.

edit.find: The thinker list is rebuilt on every scene change, so within one scene visit the loop normally plays the bundle once; whether it resumes after an inventory open/close was not checked (the loop would replay the bundle).
edit.with: Scene setup never wakes the loop: the thinker list is built after the clear at the top of scene setup, so the bundle plays once on entering the scene. It plays again after every inventory close: the overlay clears $FF at open, restores the saved thinker list at close and runs one thinker pass while $FF is still clear (UpdateFrameRender, after ResetThinkerWaitCounters) before it sets $FF again, so the wait ends in that pass.

46581.text: Park until flag $FF is cleared (the first thinker pass after an inventory close)

partNotes.HitSwitchTriggered: Runs after a hit: set the event flag whose number is in actor field $24 (the spawn type byte shifted right by one; SetFlagRaw takes it as is), show frame $10 (assumed pressed look), wait 16 ticks (WaitByte #0F), show frame $0F again, then re-arm.
